Package mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character

Class Npc

java.lang.Object
mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character.Character
mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character.Npc
public class Npc extends Character
Represents a non-player character (NPC) in the game.

An NPC inherits all functionality from Character and mainly serves as a simple game entity with no additional behavior.

    • Npc

      public Npc(String name, String description, Map<String,Integer> stats, Integer posX, Integer posY, String spriteName, Integer step)
      Creates an NPC with full initialization including its position and the sprite tile step size.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of npc
      description - NPC description
      stats - a map containing the NPC's statistics
      posX - the NPC's initial X position on the map between 0 and 50
      posY - the NPC's initial Y position on the map between 0 and 50
      spriteName - filename of the NPC's sprite
      step - tile size in pixels
